payload.text: hv, 27 Nov 2026, first-hand in vc's session, by vc's picker, answered before vc's date -u of 08:37Z. It answers ST0029's design rulings D1 and D3, which dc found unanswered in its plan of 08:29Z, as one question. hv picked "Text onward (Recommended)". The rest is vc's wording. xtrct's zsh port keeps exact its stdout, its exit status on every path, the API request (model, max_tokens, system text and user text) and xtrct's own stderr lines. When the new pdf2md is ready (ST0029's WP04), hv checks it on hv's own Talga Rd PDFs, old xtrct against new, in a run hv makes.
